'''Chee nuts''' were a type of [[Nut/Legends|nut]] that turned a deep [[Color/Legends|gray-green color]] when they became ripe.<ref name="Shadows" /> Around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] was aware of the coloration of the ripened nuts. During a [[Duel in Spaceport Nine|duel]] with a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|fallen]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] turned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] occurring around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Pavan noticed that Sing's green [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] caused the skin of the [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]] to appear the same color as ripe chee nuts.<ref name="Shadows" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chee nuts were first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a [[2008]] novel written by [[Michael Reaves]].<ref name="Shadows" />

*''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'' {{1stm}}
